incidents.name: SquidSwap unbounded internal swap sandwiched
incidents.notes: SquidSwap's public swapTokens()/sellSwappedTokens() sell the contract's own SQUID holdings through PancakeSwap with no minimum-output check, so the attacker skewed the pool inside a PancakeV3 flash loan and sandwiched the contract's swap.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0xd309f0Fd5C3b90ecFb7024eDe7D329d9582492c5 created 2024-03-10T10:33:06Z by 0xff00d2d6210a537b517138389c29c8a6bb56dad7, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x418038cd60d7ad3006075411765c34048907e7e7; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain).
